signal: PerformYard, fresh off $95M in growth funding, launched its AI-driven Meetings product to extend its performance management platform

email.body1:
Brandon, saw PerformYard, fresh off your $95M raise, launched the AI-driven Meetings product to extend the platform.

A new product on the back of growth capital usually opens more HR-buyer accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PerformYard off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brandon, quick follow-up for PerformYard.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and a new product widens the addressable list further. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PerformYard needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brandon, last bit of proof for PerformYard.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PerformYard reply rate likely compares to other funded HR-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brandon, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem. The raise-to-launch stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an HR-tech sales motion? I will tailor it to PerformYard either way.
